name: fuelwise-functions
description: FuelWise Cloud Functions (crowdsourced prices, trust, reliability, alerts). Emulator-first; never deployed without explicit approval.

scripts.test:rules: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fuelwise --only firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 lib/test/emulator/rules.test.js"
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fuelwise --only auth,firestore,functions "node --test --test-concurrency=1 lib/test/emulator/functions.test.js"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:assistant && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:assistant: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fuelwise --only firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 lib/test/emulator/assistant.test.js"
